freePlan.limits: Fully open-source library, free to use with no paid tier.

capabilities.en: Standards-focused, multi-strategy routing for React applications, deployable as a client-side library or full-stack framework mode.
Non-breaking upgrade path: v8 maintains backward compatibility with v7 APIs.
Built on a modern baseline (Node 22+, Vite 7+, React 19+, ESM-only) with an Open Governance model for community-proposed features.
Large ecosystem maturity: reported 4.5+ billion npm downloads and 3.6M+ dependent packages.

limitations.en: Requires a modern toolchain baseline (Node 22+, ESM-only) which can force upgrades in older codebases.
As a routing library rather than a hosted product, there is no vendor support tier or SLA; support is community-driven (GitHub Discussions, Discord).

reason.en: Direct type-safe routing competitor for React apps, an increasingly common alternative to React Router.

unknowns: Detailed differences between the library-only mode and the full 'framework mode' (formerly Remix) were not fully explored beyond the homepage summary.
